notes: Account: Fleetline ServeCraft (logistics routing + driver assistant). Primary ask: sub-100ms interactive routing and low per-call cost for high QPS. Team mix: infra-led (CTO+SRE), product (2 PMs), ML infra engineer. Wants clear levers to meet cost and latency SLOs. Said: "If we can hit p95 <120ms and cost < $0.25/1k tokens at our typical 128-token prompts, we can replace current vendor." Security: must run in VPC/private control plane, KMS integration mandatory, audit logs + 1yr retention. Preference for dedicated GPU pools with autoscaling and predictable tail latency. Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions (batching profiles, cache policies, quantization guidelines). POC asks: 2-week perf run, compare quantization profiles (int8 vs 4-bit), evaluate prefix caching impact for repeated route fragments, and measure cost per 1M requests. Short, choppy notes on calls are in timeline below.
